_description: The ONE list of words marking a luminaire / circuit / system as emergency lighting. Read by EmergencyNameMatcher (emergency lighting audit), CircuitWizardEngine (load classification) and SeparationChecker (service mapping). Project override: <project>/_BIM_COORD/emergency_keywords.json with the same keys - additive unless it sets "replaceBaseline": true. Must stay identical to EmergencyKeywords.BuiltIn() (asserted by EmergencyKeywordsTests).
